verdict.rationale: Bruno has no native scheduler or monitors. Its CLI and official Docker images let you run collections headlessly in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, so recurring runs are possible only by putting an external scheduler (CI cron, OS cron) around `bru run`. Missing for 10: native scheduling or recurring-job feature, documented cron/scheduled-pipeline examples, run history or monitoring for scheduled runs, and independent corroboration.
